prompt.en:
Write `chunk_words(words, size, overlap)` that splits a list of words into chunks of at most `size` words, where consecutive chunks share `overlap` words.

- Chunks start at 0, `size - overlap`, `2 * (size - overlap)`, and so on.
- Stop after the first chunk that reaches the end of the list, so no chunk is made only of overlap.
- An empty list gives no chunks. Raise `ValueError` unless `0 <= overlap < size`.
prompt.es:
Escribe `chunk_words(words, size, overlap)`, que divide una lista de palabras en fragmentos de como mucho `size` palabras, donde fragmentos consecutivos comparten `overlap` palabras.

- Los fragmentos empiezan en 0, `size - overlap`, `2 * (size - overlap)`, etc.
- Para después del primer fragmento que llega al final de la lista, para que ningún fragmento sea solo solapamiento.
- Una lista vacía no da fragmentos. Lanza `ValueError` salvo que `0 <= overlap < size`.

starter:
def chunk_words(words, size, overlap):
    raise NotImplementedError
tests:
w = "a b c d e f g".split()
assert chunk_words(w, 3, 1) == [["a", "b", "c"], ["c", "d", "e"], ["e", "f", "g"]], "step is size - overlap = 2; each chunk repeats the last word of the previous one"
assert chunk_words(w, 3, 0) == [["a", "b", "c"], ["d", "e", "f"], ["g"]], "without overlap the last chunk may be short"
assert chunk_words(w, 10, 2) == [w], "a document shorter than one chunk is a single chunk"
assert chunk_words(list("abcdef"), 4, 2) == [list("abcd"), list("cdef")], "stop once a chunk reaches the end: no chunk made only of overlap"
assert chunk_words([], 3, 1) == [], "no words, no chunks"
raised = False
try:
    chunk_words(w, 3, 3)
except ValueError:
    raised = True
assert raised, "overlap >= size would never advance: raise ValueError"

hint.en: Validate first, then loop: append `words[start:start + size]`, stop if `start + size >= len(words)`, otherwise add `size - overlap` to `start`.
hint.es: Valida primero y luego itera: añade `words[start:start + size]`, para si `start + size >= len(words)` y, si no, suma `size - overlap` a `start`.

hint.es: `re.findall(r"\[(\d+)\]", answer)` devuelve los números como texto. Conviértelos con `int`, ponlos en un `set` y sepáralos según el rango.
